pathways.name: Allegiant Accelerate
pathways.status: Conflicting page notices — confirm university intake
pathways.eligibility: Official pilot page lists KSU among partner universities. Detailed current selection criteria need confirmation.
pathways.benefits: University pathway with mentoring and conditional progression described by KSU.
pathways.commitments: Obtain current university agreement, time-building obligations and any repayment terms.
pathways.next_step: Ask KSU whether its current Accelerate cohort is accepting applicants. The airline page says both that the pathway window is closed and that Accelerate cadets are accepted; do not infer an open application.

pathways.name: CommuteAir / KSU relationship
pathways.status: School relationship listed; standalone cadet intake unverified
pathways.eligibility: KSU lists CommuteAir. That does not establish a currently open student cadet program or personal eligibility.
pathways.benefits: Airline career and Aviate resources are published by CommuteAir.
pathways.commitments: Verify current employment and Aviate terms separately.
pathways.next_step: Check current recruiting resources and ask KSU what student opportunities the relationship provides.

pathways.name: Delta Propel — Collegiate & CFI
pathways.status: Application route published; personal eligibility unconfirmed
pathways.eligibility: Current Delta criteria include a qualifying AABI program, active CFI work, being within 12 months of ATP/R-ATP eligibility, first-class medical and travel/work eligibility. KSU appears on its affiliate list.
pathways.benefits: Propel Talent Community offers earlier engagement; full program describes a conditional career route through Endeavor.
pathways.commitments: Review current program and Endeavor transition terms; no guaranteed date to mainline.
pathways.next_step: Explore Talent Community now; revisit full application once actively instructing and approaching ATP/R-ATP eligibility.

pathways.name: JetBlue Gateway University
pathways.status: Program details published; live application window unconfirmed
pathways.eligibility: Partner-school student with at least an instrument rating, or instructor; KSU is listed. Selection and employment requirements also apply.
pathways.benefits: Conditional route with prescribed education and experience building.
pathways.commitments: Published framework includes at least 500 hours of dual given at the partner school and subsequent flying at a partner or Part 121 regional. Confirm carrier-specific obligations.
pathways.next_step: Locate the current application requisition and ask how KSU instructor hiring affects completing the 500-hour requirement.

pathways.name: Republic RJet Cadet
pathways.status: Application page published; confirm acceptance at application destination
pathways.eligibility: Published requisition distinguishes R-ATP and unrestricted ATP routes; instrument versus commercial requirements differ. It also lists checkride, medical, work-eligibility and timing limits. Confirm current requirements directly.
pathways.benefits: Conditional offer, recruiting contact and events described by the requisition.
pathways.commitments: The cadet requisition says no contractual commitment; verify any later employment/training agreement separately.
pathways.next_step: Review the complete requisition and live Apply destination; ask recruiter to clarify the hour/timing-limit wording.

pathways.name: Southwest Destination 225° — University
pathways.status: University page says applications currently closed
pathways.eligibility: Partner-university route requires education, private certificate, medical eligibility and other selection criteria. KSU is listed.
pathways.benefits: Mentoring and a defined route through partner flying employers.
pathways.commitments: School instructor commitment and partner-dependent service apply; page says most flight partners require two years.
pathways.next_step: Your prior application ended at final interview. Reapplication waiting period was not verified; consult your decision email or program recruiter before planning another application.

pathways.name: United Aviate — University
pathways.status: KSU listing confirmed; airline detail page blocked during audit
pathways.eligibility: KSU lists Aviate. Current airline eligibility and KSU participation details require direct review.
pathways.benefits: University entry into an airline career-development route, subject to current program rules.
pathways.commitments: Obtain the latest Aviate Program Guide; confirm permitted time-building employers and transition requirements.
pathways.next_step: Open current Aviate university/network pages and program guide; do not use older transition-hour figures.
